title: Longest Collatz chain below 10000
prompt:
The Collatz sequence of a positive integer n repeats this step until it reaches 1: if n is even, replace it with half of n; otherwise replace it with 3n + 1. The number of steps is the number of replacements needed to reach 1 (for n = 1 it is 0, for n = 6 it is 8).

Among the starting numbers 1 to 9999, find the one with the most steps (it is unique). Print that starting number on the first line and its number of steps on the second line.
